\widetilde{\mathcal U}_x(\bar\tau)$ is the pre-image of $q$,  and
that $\gamma_Z$ is the  ${\mathcal L}$-geodesic to $q$ determined by
$Z$. Suppose  that $Y(\tau)$ is an adapted vector field along
$\gamma_Z$. Then
